input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment, so password reset (and other) email links point at localhost for users instead of the real app host. This appears to be happening in production, meaning PUBLIC_URL is likely missing from that environment's config, or the fallback itself needs to be replaced with a required/validated production URL. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is always set in production and/or failing loudly if it's missing, rather than silently defaulting to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset and other emails linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and that fallback is what's ending up in the password reset email link (and the rollup/report links too). This suggests PUBLIC_URL isn't being set in the production environment, so the app silently falls back to localhost instead of failing loudly.

Proposed fix: require PUBLIC_URL to be set in production and fail fast (e.g. throw at startup or during config validation) if it's missing, rather than silently defaulting to localhost. Alternatively, source BASE_URL from the existing `config` module (which likely already validates required environment variables) instead of reading process.env directly in this file. Also verify the production deployment configuration actually sets PUBLIC_URL to the correct public URL.
